class.name: JRPGUsableData
class.brief_description: Base class of skills and items.
class.description: What skills and items have in common: who they target, where they can be used, how they hit, the damage they cause and their effects. Percentages are whole percent values as shown in the editor.

method.name: is_usable_in_battle
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member occasion] allows use in battle.

method.name: is_usable_in_menu
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member occasion] allows use from the menu.

members.member: ID of the battle animation played on use, [code]0[/code] for none, or [constant ANIMATION_NORMAL_ATTACK] to use the animation of the user's weapon.
If [code]true[/code], the damage can be a critical hit.
Element of the damage: an element ID, [code]0[/code] for none, or [constant ELEMENT_NORMAL_ATTACK] to use the user's attack elements.

Expression that computes the base amount, for example [code]a.atk * 4 - b.def * 2[/code]. [code]a[/code] is the user, [code]b[/code] the target and [code]v[n][/code] reads game variable [code]n[/code]. Element rates and guarding are applied afterwards and do not belong in the formula.
What the damage does: lower, raise or drain HP or MP, or nothing.
Random spread of the amount in percent: with 20, an amount of 100 lands between 80 and 120.
Help text shown while the cursor is on the skill or item.
Additional effects, as dictionaries with [code]code[/code], [code]data_id[/code], [code]value1[/code] and [code]value2[/code].
How hitting is decided and which reactions (counterattack, reflection, substitute) can happen.
Index of the icon in the project's icon sheet.
Where it can be used: anywhere, only in battle, only from the menu, or never.
Number of random targets when [member target_count] is [constant COUNT_RANDOM].
How many times the effect is applied per use, from 1 to 9.
Added to the user's agility when deciding the order of actions, from -2000 to 2000.
Base chance of success in percent.
Whether it affects one target, all targets or random targets.
Which side it targets: enemies, allies, both, the user, or nobody.
For allies, whether it targets the living, the knocked out, or anyone.
TP the user gains when the use succeeds.

constants.constant: Usable in battle and from the menu.
Always hits when the use succeeds; counterattack, reflection and substitute do not apply.
Hit decided by the user's accuracy against the target's evasion; counterattack and substitute can apply.
Hit decided against the target's magic evasion; reflection and substitute can apply.
Takes HP from the target and gives it to the user.
Takes MP from the target and gives it to the user.
Element value meaning "the user's attack elements".
Animation value meaning "the animation of the user's weapon".
